prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ONLY_DWT_catboost', seasonality_champion='CWT_catboost', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: ONLY_DWT_catboost dominates with perfect trend correlation (1.0) and best overall RMSE (197.87), while CWT_catboost leads seasonality capture (0.698). However, rankings are highly unstable (Kendall τ=0.064) with extreme RMSE spread (7.86x), indicating model disagreement. The series shows concept drift and autocorrelated residuals across most models, making robust median/trimmed-mean combinations preferable over weighted stacking to avoid overfitting noise.
